$comment: The manifest of a signed schema and vocabulary bundle (ADR 0005, 'Bundle format'). Rust type: portitor_dcp::bundle::Manifest, which also checks what JSON Schema cannot: the issue date and time is a real one, file paths are unique (ignoring case), and context URLs are unique. Roles (ADR 0005, amended in 0.13): the four roles of this version are closed (no other field); a role object with any other type is valid, and a reader that does not know it skips the file.
title: Portitor bundle manifest

version.description: The bundle version; also the name of its folder.

issued.description: When the version was issued (dcterms:issued, W3C DCAT 3): an xsd:dateTime in UTC, to the second, without fractions. A connector following the newest version never takes one issued before the version it uses.

profile.description: The profile IRI stated as dct:conformsTo by a dataset that passes the shapes.

contains.description: At least one file has a role of this version. A manifest in which a reader knows no role is refused: it would give no rules at all.

path.description: Relative path inside the bundle folder, '/' between folders; no part starts with '.'; not manifest.json or manifest.jws.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes, lowercase hex.

mediaType.description: A media type without parameters: type/subtype, each a restricted name of RFC 6838 section 4.2. For the four known roles only three are valid (see allOf below).

oneOf.description: SHACL shapes for dataset metadata, for these dct:accessRights values.
Ontologies and code lists, as data for sh:class checks.
A JSON-LD context, standing for the context at url.

A role of a later version of this format: any type that is not one of the four above, with any other fields. A reader that does not know the type skips the file: it does not fetch it and does not enforce what it holds.

allOf.description: Shapes and vocabularies are RDF. A file with a role of a later version may have any media type of the shape above: a reader that does not know the role skips the file.
